title: MiR Robot Configuration Schema
description: Schema for MiR robot configuration files

$schema.description: The schema for the configuration file

model.description: The model name of the robot

top_module.description: The top module attached to the robot

compatible_products.description: The compatible products for the robot

has_broom.description: Whether the robot has a broom attachment

has_proximity_sensors.description: Whether the robot has proximity sensors

has_mechanical_brake_switch.description: Whether the robot has a mechanical brake switch

has_top_plate.description: Whether the robot has a top plate

has_inbuilt_display.description: Whether the robot has an inbuilt display

has_power_over_ethernet_service_port.description: Whether the robot has power over ethernet service port

has_estop_box.description: Whether the robot is delivered with an emergency stop box

has_fast_swap.description: Whether the robot has a fast swap feature

has_pull_handles.description: Whether the robot has pull handles

min_caster_wheel_diameter.description: Minimum caster wheel diameter in millimeters

min_drive_wheel_diameter.description: Minimum drive wheel diameter in millimeters

min_cleanroom_caster_wheel_diameter.description: Minimum cleanroom wheel diameter in mm

max_current_power_pins_1_and_3_standstil.description: Maximum current for power pins 1 and 3 in amperes when robot is at standstill

max_current_power_pins_1_and_3_driving.description: Maximum current for power pins 1 and 3 in amperes when robot is driving. If there is no difference between standstill and driving, set this to the same value as max_current_power_pins_1_and_3_standstill.

task_grease_drive_wheels.description: Whether greasing drive wheels is a required maintenance task

task_check_drive_wheel_shaft.description: Whether checking drive wheel shaft is a required maintenance task

task_clean_heat_sink.description: Whether cleaning the heat sink is a required maintenance task

location_ethernet_service_port.description: Location of the ethernet service port

number_of_batteries.description: Number of batteries in the robot

is_deckload.description: Whether the robot is a deckload variant

is_forklift.description: Whether the robot is a forklift variant

is_shelf_lift.description: Whether the robot is a shelf lift variant

has_esd_variant.description: Whether the robot has an ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) variant

is_pcm.description: Whether the robot is PCM (Pallet Cart Module)

is_ce.description: Whether the robot is CE certified

name_sick_configuration_file.description: Name of the SICK configuration file

checksum_safety_plc.description: Checksum of the safety PLC configuration file

checksum_rear_scanner_function.description: Checksum of the rear SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_rear_scanner_function_network.description: Checksum of the rear SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_scanner_function.description: Checksum of the front SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_scanner_function_network.description: Checksum of the front SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_left_scanner_function.description: Checksum of the front left SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_left_scanner_function_net.description: Checksum of the front left SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_right_scanner_function.description: Checksum of the front right SICK scanner configuration file

checksum_front_right_scanner_function_ne.description: Checksum of the front right SICK scanner configuration file

min_sick_supported_software_version.description: Minimum supported software version for the applied SICK configuration file

has_two_pins_for_reduced_speed_function.description: Whether the robot has two pins for the reduced speed function. False assumes one pin.

image_declaration_of_conformity.description: The path to the declaration of conformity image

image_declaration_of_incorporation.description: The path to the declaration of incorporation image

image_battery_remove.description: The path to the battery removal image

image_power_button.description: The path to an image the shows the power button while the robot is off

image_power_button_turn_on.description: The path to an image that shows the power button being turned on

image_start_up_lights.description: The path to an image that shows the status lights during startup

image_restart_button.description: The path to an image that shows the restart (resume) button

image_packaging_material.description: The path to an image that shows the packaging material used for the robot
